shortDescription: Manages traffic types on CloudStack Physical Networks

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: hyperv_networklabel
options.description: The network name label of the physical device dedicated to this traffic on a HyperV host.

options.name: isolation_method
options.description: Use if the physical network has multiple isolation types and traffic type is public.

options.name: kvm_networklabel
options.description: The network name label of the physical device dedicated to this traffic on a KVM host.

options.name: ovm3_networklabel
options.description: The network name of the physical device dedicated to this traffic on an OVM3 host.

options.name: physical_network
options.description: the name of the Physical Network

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: traffic_type
options.description: the trafficType to be added to the physical network.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: The VLAN id to be used for Management traffic by VMware host.

options.name: vmware_networklabel
options.description: The network name label of the physical device dedicated to this traffic on a VMware host.

options.name: xen_networklabel
options.description: The network name label of the physical device dedicated to this traffic on a XenServer host.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone with the physical network.
